description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the IDGeneratorDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests the functionality related to generating and updating IDs for entities such as Employee, Module, and User.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing IDGeneratorDao methods in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It verifies current ID retrieval and updating the next ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of IDGeneratorDao and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetCurrentID
methods.description: Tests the getCurrentID method for Employee, Module, and User classes to ensure correct current ID values.

methods.name: testUpdateNextId
methods.description: Tests the updateNextId method for Employee class and verifies that the current ID is updated correctly.
